implementation.scope: Scientific prose only; original support statuses preserved; full-text gaps remain separate

claims.claim: The intended Sjostrand article was published in 1999 and sampled medial quadriceps; PMID 9886964 identifies an unrelated osteocyte paper.
limitations: Full-text publisher access returned HTTP 403; full text remains on the existing wishlist.
Abstract supports concentration differences, not a complete saturable-transport model.

claims.claim: An effect compartment may use plasma-equivalent units; use of a plasma-referenced EC50 is not inherently an error without knowing state definition and calibration.
limitations: Modelling inference, not experimental evidence or a code audit.

claims.source_path: C:/Dropbox/Kristian/Diabetes/Diabetes Simulator - Virtuel udforskning af din virkelighed/docs/references/Basu_2015_IntravascularInterstitialGlucoseLag.pdf
claims.region: Abstract; Results tracer lag estimates and catheter-dead-space correction
claims.claim: Results report tracer-specific mean (SE) delays 7.1 (0.8) and 8.1 (1.0) minutes after correcting for 6.2 minutes of dead-space transit; abstract reports a different summary statistic and Results contain conflicting maximum-delay statements.
claims.population_comparison_timepoint: Six fasting adults with T1D maintained on intravenous insulin; first detectable infused-tracer enrichment in abdominal microdialysate under near-steady glycaemia.
limitations: Do not conflate tracer first appearance, abstract median, sensor lag and a first-order model time constant.
Original Results mention 10.8 minutes but then call 9.8 the overall maximum; not reconciled.

claims.source_path: C:/Dropbox/Kristian/Diabetes/Diabetes Simulator - Virtuel udforskning af din virkelighed/docs/references/Beck_2019_TimeInRangeAndHbA1c.pdf
claims.region: Methods; Table 4A and 4B; Table 5A headers, regression equations and individual prediction limits
claims.claim: Pooled CGM intervention-arm associations include 545 month-six observations and 455 change observations. At +10 TIR percentage points the predicted HbA1c change is -0.57 percentage points, individual limits -1.74 to +0.60; the fitted slope is -0.033 with intercept -0.24, not -0.06.
claims.population_comparison_timepoint: Adults with T1D from CGM treatment arms of four trials; baseline to six months; 14 days CGM required at month six, 10 at baseline for change analysis.
limitations: Observational regression within selected trial arms, not a randomized effect of a TIR increment.
Individual prediction interval is not the narrower confidence interval for the mean.
Separate reverse regressions are not algebraic inverses.

claims.source_path: C:/Dropbox/Kristian/Diabetes/Diabetes Simulator - Virtuel udforskning af din virkelighed/docs/references/Boyle_1995_BrainGlucoseUptakeHypoglycemia.pdf
claims.region: Methods, Table 1, Table 2, Figure 2 and Results
claims.claim: Twenty-four T1D participants in three HbA1c groups were studied at approximately 105 and 54 mg/dL; the fifteen controls were previously reported and compared at 85 and 55 mg/dL. Low-HbA1c T1D group had no significant decrease in brain glucose uptake, not directly measured transporter upregulation.
claims.population_comparison_timepoint: Controlled hypoglycaemic plateaus; healthy historical controls, not a randomised comparison of preceding glycaemic exposure.
limitations: Groups differ in preceding hypoglycaemia; controls differ in protocol baseline.
Arterial-jugular balance times cerebral blood flow is a tissue uptake measurement, not molecular transporter expression.

claims.source_path: C:/Dropbox/Kristian/Diabetes/Diabetes Simulator - Virtuel udforskning af din virkelighed/docs/references/Gerich_2001_RW_RenalGluconeogenesis.pdf
claims.region: Table 2 and adjacent postabsorptive glucose-release and gluconeogenesis sections
claims.claim: Ten study estimates span 5-28% renal contribution to total glucose release, with an unweighted mean of 20%; approximately 40% of gluconeogenesis uses a different denominator.
claims.population_comparison_timepoint: Review synthesis of studies in normal postabsorptive humans; not a T1D pooled cohort.
limitations: Underlying primary trials not independently re-appraised.
Range is between studies, not an individual clinical reference interval.
Current BG conditional 20-25% summary is not contradicted.
